name: Luigelo Davila
headline: I design how data and automation reach your apps: fast, efficient and built around the people using them.
availability: Open to senior full-stack and mobile roles, remote in the EU or B2B.
summary: I've spent 5 years taking software from architecture to production across web, mobile, backend and cloud.

At **Zoloo** (formerly Boloo), a SaaS platform for bol.com sellers with €2.5B+ in member sales and 20,000+ orders a day, I own the native iOS app and lead the migration of core business domains from a monolith to microservices, including moving 40M+ historical records while the system stayed in production.
Before that I led a customer-facing microservices portal at **Applus+**, and I built and launched **Syncflow**, an AI goal planner, as a solo founder.

principles.title: Analyse with AI, confirm with people, ship in small steps
principles.text: I first analyse with the help of AI to go faster. Then I confirm with the team, especially with the people who know the product better than any model. Then I execute progressively, always thinking about the final user.
principles.linkLabel: See it in the Zoloo invoicing migration

principles.title: Own the product, not just the code
principles.text: I like owning what I build and making decisions based on data and user feedback. With AI that matters even more: I define the architecture, the requirements and the constraints, and agents implement inside feedback loops that review every change. Without someone owning the product, AI leads to security issues and a messy codebase.

principles.title: Keep it simple, fast and cheap to run
principles.text: When there's messy code or something nobody fully understands, I dig in, ask, clean it up and improve it. Simple systems cost less to run, and stay fast enough that users never notice them.
